Dubai: DMCC's diamond trade hit a record $41.7 billion in 2025, announced in July, as its second Dubai Diamond Week opens.

The conference opened Monday; the jewellery show runs to Thursday, with tours of Almas Tower. "Dubai has firmly established itself as one of the world's leading centres," said DMCC's Bin Sulayem.

دبي: تقول دبي للسلع المتعددة إن تجارة الماس سجلت رقماً قياسياً بلغ 41.7 مليار دولار في 2025، مع انطلاق أسبوع دبي للألماس.
